India-EU Free Trade Agreement Targeted for December Signing

India and the European Union are nearing a Free Trade Agreement, with plans to sign it in December and implement it by early 2027. Union Minister Piyush Goyal announced that the pact is expected to grant Indian exporters near-zero duty access to the European market, potentially opening significant export opportunities.
